targetDocuments.title: Governor's Office of Planning and Research - Website Accessibility Certification
targetDocuments.note: Page publique reelle, certification de conformite WCAG 2.0 AA avec exceptions documentees.
targetDocuments.content:
Accessibility / Help Page
Updated: July 1, 2023

The Governor's Office of Planning and Research certifies that its websites comply with Government Code Section 11546.7, as follows:

The Governor's Office of Planning and Research certifies compliance with Government Code Section 7405.
The Governor's Office of Planning and Research certifies compliance with Government Code Section 11135.

Consistent with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.0, the Governor's Office of Planning and Research issues a statement of partial conformance as third-party documents existing on its main website (opr.ca.gov). This website does not fully conform, but would fully conform to WCAG 2.0 at a Level AA standard if the following non-conforming parts were removed:

Documents prepared pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) that are required to be submitted to the State Clearinghouse at the Governor's Office of Planning and Research and made publicly available through an online database known as the CEQAnet Web Portal. (Pub. Resources Code, Section 21159.9, subd. (b).)

The Governor's Office of Planning and Research does not control the content expressly listed above. With exception to these uncontrolled parts, the Governor's Office of Planning and Research certifies that its websites conform to WCAG 2.0 at a Level AA standard.

If you have difficulty accessing any material on our website, please contact us at accessibility@opr.ca.gov and we will correct the problem or work to provide the information in an alternative format.

targetDocuments.content:
Website accessibility certification

2025 Certification

Agency: Office of the Governor

Certification date: January 6, 2025

Website: results.ca.gov

Contact: doug.hunting@gov.ca.gov

The undersigned certify that, as of January 6, 2025 the website of the Office of the Governor is designed, developed, and maintained to be accessible. This denotes compliance with the following:

- California Government Code Sections 7405, 11135, and 11546.7
- Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2 published by the Web Accessibility Initiative of the World Wide Web Consortium
- At a minimum Level AA success criteria

Doug Hunting
Chief Information Officer
(Signature on file) January 6, 2025

Miroslava de la O
Director
(Signature on file) January 6, 2025
